title: Avuhz Slice 1 Foundational Identifiers v1
description: Provider-neutral, bounded identifier primitives for the Avuhz Slice 1 contract boundary. Canonical internal UUIDs are distinct from opaque external references.

canonicalUuid.title: Canonical UUID
canonicalUuid.description: Lowercase RFC 4122/9562 textual UUID used for Avuhz-owned canonical identities.

engagementId.title: Engagement ID
engagementId.description: Canonical Avuhz engagement identity; never an acquisition or provider account ID.

commandId.title: Command ID
commandId.description: Unique identity for one command attempt.

correlationId.title: Correlation ID
correlationId.description: Identity correlating one bounded business interaction.

causationId.title: Causation ID
causationId.description: Identity of the accepted command or event that directly caused another action.

eventId.title: Event ID
eventId.description: Unique identity for one immutable lifecycle event.

approvalId.title: Approval ID
approvalId.description: Canonical identity for one attributable human approval record.

oiaAssessmentPlanId.title: OIA Assessment Plan ID
oiaAssessmentPlanId.description: Canonical identity for one versioned client-specific OIA assessment plan resource.

oiaInspectionItemId.title: OIA Inspection Item ID
oiaInspectionItemId.description: Canonical identity for one first-class OIA diagnostic inspection item.

assessmentAccessGrantId.title: Assessment Access Grant ID
assessmentAccessGrantId.description: Canonical identity for one temporary diagnostic assessment access authority record.

diagnosticPaymentVerificationId.title: Diagnostic Payment Verification ID
diagnosticPaymentVerificationId.description: Canonical identity for one diagnostic/OIA payment verification record.

diagnosticAgreementAuthorityId.title: Diagnostic Agreement Authority ID
diagnosticAgreementAuthorityId.description: Canonical identity for one verified diagnostic/OIA agreement-authority record.

scopeId.title: Diagnostic Scope ID
scopeId.description: Canonical identity for a diagnostic scope aggregate.

handoffId.title: Acquisition Handoff ID
handoffId.description: Canonical Avuhz identity for an accepted handoff snapshot; provider/source references remain separate.

opaqueReferenceId.title: Opaque Provider-Neutral Reference Identifier
opaqueReferenceId.description: Bounded opaque reference for an external or provider-owned object. It is never a canonical Avuhz internal identity and carries no credential material.

schemaIdentifier.title: Schema Identifier
schemaIdentifier.description: Immutable Avuhz contract schema URN with an explicit major version.

idempotencyKey.title: Idempotency Key
idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated bounded key for one semantic command request. It must not contain credential material.
